title: HomeShield Program Schedule: Dwelling and Property Coverages
content:
Calloway Insurance Agency writes Homeowners Insurance on Calloway homes under six HomeShield programs. Each program is written for a band of dwelling coverage (Coverage A), from the lowest to the highest Coverage A the program writes, and each program sets other structures (Coverage B), personal property (Coverage C) and loss of use (Coverage D) as a percentage of Coverage A.

## Schedule of property coverages

| Program | Lowest Coverage A written (USD) | Highest Coverage A written (USD) | Coverage B, other structures | Coverage C, personal property | Coverage D, loss of use |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| HomeShield Essential | 150,000 (150000) | 299,999 (299999) | 10 percent of Coverage A | 50 percent of Coverage A | 10 percent of Coverage A |
| HomeShield Standard | 300,000 (300000) | 449,999 (449999) | 10 percent of Coverage A | 50 percent of Coverage A | 20 percent of Coverage A |
| HomeShield Plus | 450,000 (450000) | 599,999 (599999) | 10 percent of Coverage A | 60 percent of Coverage A | 20 percent of Coverage A |
| HomeShield Preferred | 600,000 (600000) | 799,999 (799999) | 10 percent of Coverage A | 70 percent of Coverage A | 20 percent of Coverage A |
| HomeShield Premier | 800,000 (800000) | 1,099,999 (1099999) | 15 percent of Coverage A | 75 percent of Coverage A | 30 percent of Coverage A |
| HomeShield Estate | 1,100,000 (1100000) | 2,500,000 (2500000) | 20 percent of Coverage A | 75 percent of Coverage A | 30 percent of Coverage A |

Both ends of each band are written by that program: a Coverage A equal to the lowest figure or equal to the highest figure falls inside the band. The bands meet without a gap, so every whole-dollar Coverage A from 150,000 to 2,500,000 dollars falls in exactly one program.

## Reading the schedule

Coverage B, C and D are not separate dollar figures on the schedule; each is the stated percentage of the policy's own Coverage A.

**Worked illustration (hypothetical Coverage A).** A home insured under HomeShield Plus with a hypothetical Coverage A of 500,000 dollars carries:

- Coverage B of 10 percent of 500,000, that is 50,000 dollars;
- Coverage C of 60 percent of 500,000, that is 300,000 dollars;
- Coverage D of 20 percent of 500,000, that is 100,000 dollars.

The same hypothetical 500,000 dollars of Coverage A under HomeShield Standard would not be written at all, since 500,000 lies above the 449,999 dollar top of that program's band.

## Band boundaries in figures

| Coverage A (hypothetical) | Program whose band contains it |
|---|---|
| 299,999 | HomeShield Essential |
| 300,000 | HomeShield Standard |
| 599,999 | HomeShield Plus |
| 600,000 | HomeShield Preferred |
| 1,099,999 | HomeShield Premier |
| 1,100,000 | HomeShield Estate |
